scope: Read-only review of the R2 negative-case planning vectors and R3 errata. This review creates no fixtures, schema/runtime result, public command acceptance, provider call, source/test/Git change, or resealed resource.

reviewer.role: independent bounded public-resource negative-case errata reviewer

inputs.r2_scope: Additive correction to R1. The cases remain planning vectors for the future R12 ten-schema/profile packet; no public command, installed resource, remote acquisition, or runtime result is claimed.

checks.r2_observation: Set a present target's text to null while leaving reason null.
checks.r3_rule: Set the present normalized target text to null, preserve the target as present, and add no reason field. The present target shape has no reason property; leaving reason:null would test the wrong object shape.
checks.planning_boundary: No public schema validator or runtime replay is run here.

checks.r2_observation: Replace a bound Ref sha256 with a different valid lowercase 64-hex digest.
checks.r3_rule: Keep the deliberately wrong bound Ref.sha256. After the mutation, recompute only the containing config envelope ce1 ID and complete saved-byte hash, then update consumers that point to that config. Never restore the corrupted Ref from the referenced file.
checks.isolation: The invalid Ref digest remains wrong immediately before later validation; consumer resealing must not repair it.

checks.r2_observation: Change the ce1 request id's digest while keeping its kind, schema, and data unchanged.
checks.r3_rule: Keep the intentionally wrong request envelope id while retaining schema, kind and data. Do not reseal that request id. Compute the invalid request’s actual saved-byte hash and update consumers to those saved bytes together with the intentionally wrong id.
checks.isolation: Do not globally reseal the request or derive a corrected id; only dependent saved-byte/consumer references may change.

protocol_review.starting_point: An otherwise valid dependency set is required before each mutation.
protocol_review.single_mutation: Apply exactly one listed mutation and explicitly select the target field.
protocol_review.reseal_scope: Recompute only non-target IDs, saved-byte hashes and containing/consumer references needed to bind the mutated graph.
protocol_review.target_assertion: Assert the selected target remains invalid immediately before later validation/replay.
protocol_review.semantic_replay: Run only after full reseal/rebind with unchanged dependencies valid; R2 intentionally asserts rejection, not a public error code or precedence.
protocol_review.future_profile_dependencies: Cases requiring unavailable R12 profile/resources remain unavailable and are not fabricated here.

boundary_conclusion: The R3 errata are internally consistent and correctly repair the three requested vectors. NEG-009 is structural schema preparation; NEG-021 and NEG-022 remain semantic rejection vectors. This is planning evidence only and does not establish schema, public runtime, resource, or provider behavior.
